Initial release — instantly convert images to animated video clips with no editing software.

- Upload JPG, PNG, WEBP, or HEIC images up to 200MB and generate 5-second video clips in 30–90 seconds.
- Automatic cloud-based processing: just describe the animation you want; no manual editing or setup required.
- Export videos in 1080p MP4 format and other common file types.
- Built-in free credit system and easy anonymous access—no account required for basic use.
- Supports batch processing, timeline edits, and additional features like text overlays or background music.
